items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: It's something that Raymond Burke and Tom Brown and I discussed.

ctx.x: They were, except for O. Not now. At least, I don't think it was standard. No. It may have been an old one that had been revived. It was an old one.

Was it? According to Tom. Mm-hmm. I can just remember that. It's something that Raymond Burke and Tom Brown and I discussed. I mean, Raymond told me that. Mm-hmm. Raymond is full of miscellaneous information that he picked up talking to Sidney Aaron and Tom Brown or somebody one time or another.

I can remember another. It was on the back of one of their records. It was a song called Bessie Couldn't Help It that was done, if I'm not mistaken, by Bing Crosby with the Paul Whiteman band. A little novelty, semi-novelty tune.
